style: Refine every catalog object toward warm, softly lit cartoon art, consistent with the selected plant reference. Preserve identity, function and original palette family. Keep registered camera, dimensions, roots, sockets, ports, footprints and animation timing. No preferred horizontal light direction for rotatable world sprites; no directional ground shadows. Real 3D render output, editable Blender sources. The source 2D effects remain explicitly identified as 2D. Each object receives fresh independent editor/judge agents. Publish object-by-object to the same PR preview; integrate approved sprites into Godot after catalog review checks. Follow-on design exploration: improve the modeling itself, including forms, proportions, structure, crafted details and decorations. Original part counts and awkward geometry are not constraints. The editor may rebuild native geometry to achieve the better design; the judge should reward useful improvements. Preserve the locked registration, gameplay contact/clearance, animation and modular continuity contract. See modeling-policy.json version2.

source.scene: Inspect the named asset collection; do not use an unrelated active scene

target.interpretation: Reward useful native modeling and decoration inspired by the target. Do not reject a change solely because it differs from the source. Reject target drift only when it harms the chosen style, readability, role or locked technical contract. Original part counts and weak shapes are not automatically constraints.

generation.inspection: Raw generated image inspected. Soft rounded materials and edge reflections, native palette and object role recognizable; purposeful organic detail encouraged by modeling policy v2. Model/root/capture/animation constraints remain native editor responsibility.

qualityCriteria.definitionOfGood: A recognizably cobalt underwater rock bank with more deliberate organic massing, softer volume and readable material planes, which remains quiet scenery beside the yellow submarine and creature silhouettes. Reward useful native reconstruction. The fixed target guides design quality; it does not supply camera, placement, exact brightness or unseen surfaces.

priorityOutcomes.outcome: A coherent broad crown and smaller overlapping stone masses with purposeful variation in shoulders, contours and proportions. Edges and face transitions feel softly finished rather than repeated straight-sided octagonal pillars. The four facings read as one believable native bank.
visibleChecks: Compare every native and published facing with original and fixed target.
At logical and phone scale, large masses remain distinct without requiring fine cracks to explain the silhouette.
Useful changes to part count, topology and construction are allowed; source part count4 is descriptive, not a lock.

priorityOutcomes.outcome: Retain the blue/cobalt palette family and background scenery role. Gentle blue value/hue separation describes the rock masses. Lower planes retain enough information to avoid large dead navy rectangles, while the whole bank stays quieter than actor focal details.
visibleChecks: Inspect on neutral light/gray/dark backgrounds and the actual declared submarine/eel context.
Phone context retains a clear yellow actor focal point and recognizable creature silhouette.
Do not copy the target's white-cyan luminous seam network or raise all faces to foreground brightness simply to match its large preview.

priorityOutcomes.outcome: Broad soft highlights roll across crown and shoulders and reveal native volume. The light has no preferred horizontal key and no directional ground cast shadow. Highlights remain controlled blue reflections rather than clipped glare, bloom or halo.
visibleChecks: Compare N/E/S/W under one unchanged measured camera/light/material contract.
No view-specific brightening, world-facing baked spotlight, hard false stripe or glowing outline.
Symmetric broad lighting and other native shader/normal/material methods are permissible; source wattage and old faceting are historical implementation, not mandatory style.

priorityOutcomes.outcome: The stone surfaces have deliberate large-scale plane and edge variation. A small number of chips, dimples or fractures may add character when they survive use size and support the stone construction. Detail remains restrained enough for quiet background scenery.
visibleChecks: No random microtexture, dense seam lattice, noise coating or pasted target pixels.
No obligation to reproduce every pit or crack from a single generated view.
All required unseen sides have a coherent finish; blank source backs are not protected from improvement.

priorityOutcomes.outcome: All required exports are clean and grounded: no black dead patches, abrupt bad normals, coplanar overlap, open exposed bottoms, broken corners, clipping, detached stones, accidental transparency or edge halos. Intended crevices remain controlled and legible.
visibleChecks: Inspect native, published2x, logical192x352, half-logical64px-cell study and actual320px-phone/landscape contexts.
Inspect repeated3x3 at declared one-cell spacing as a density and silhouette study, not a modular seam obligation.
Retain both Chromium modes; native composition and CSS-filtered screenshots are distinct evidence layers, not assumed pixel-identical.

Five frozen visible outcomes: coherent organic stone volumes; original cobalt palette and quiet background role; controlled broad soft blue plane/edge highlights; purposeful restrained stone detail; grounded artifact-free readability in every required view/use context. Fixed target guides style/forms, not camera/brightness/placement/unseen-view truth.
